name: Poland

latest_census.notes: Narodowy Spis Powszechny Ludności i Mieszkań 2021 (NSP 2021). Asks przynależność narodowo-etniczna (national-ethnic affiliation), język używany w domu (language used at home) and przynależność do wyznania religijnego (religious affiliation). The religion question was voluntary and a large share refused (packet national record: 20.9% refused), so any composition must carry a refused/not-stated category. Known methodological caveat (from prior knowledge, verify in the table headers): the ethnicity question allows a first and a second identification, so a composition has to pick one basis. All three fields are published subnationally in final-results tables released 28 Sep 2023.

subnational_sources.evidence: Search result title names the page; the search summary says the page carries XLSX tables published 28 Sep 2023 on national-ethnic affiliation 'for the country and territorial units', language used at home 'for the country and territorial units', and religious affiliation 'according to territorial divisions of the country, including voivodeships, counties and communes'; it also names 'Tablica 6: LUDNOŚĆ WEDŁUG PRZYNALEŻNOŚCI DO WYZNANIA RELIGIJNEGO I WOJEWÓDZTW W 2021 R.'. Poland has 16 voivodeships (= packet admin1 16) and 380 powiats incl. 66 cities with powiat rights (= packet admin2 380). Which of the three fields is tabulated at powiat level (vs. only voivodeship) is stated for religion; for ethnicity and language the snippet says 'territorial units' without listing levels -- confirm on the page.

subnational_sources.evidence: Search results confirm BDL (https://bdl.stat.gov.pl/bdl/) exposes data via REST API in XML and JSON and covers gminas, powiats, voivodeships. No search result confirmed that the NSP 2021 nationality/language/religion variables are loaded into BDL; the summary only said one 'would need to access these through the web interface or the REST API'. Treat as a route to check, not an established table.

tier_reason: Census counts of ethnicity, home language and religion, published as XLSX by GUS for voivodeships (16 = admin1) and powiats (380 = admin2) and gminas.
recommended_action: Fetch the XLSX workbooks from the GUS 'Tablice z ostatecznymi danymi...' page. Join admin1 on voivodeship name (16) and admin2 on powiat (380); city-counties appear in GUS tables as 'm. X' / 'Powiat m. X' while the boundary file has bare city names ('Białystok', 'Siemianowice Śląskie'), so normalise or, better, join on the TERYT code if the workbook carries one. Keep 'refused to answer' as a category for religion and record which identification (first/any) the ethnicity table uses. Confirm on the page which fields have a powiat-level table; if one is voivodeship-only, check BDL for that variable.

summary: Poland is a straightforward Tier A. The 2021 census asked national-ethnic affiliation, language used at home and religion, and GUS published final-results XLSX tables for the country, voivodeships, powiats and gminas on 28 September 2023 (page: 'Tablice z ostatecznymi danymi w zakresie przynależności narodowo-etnicznej, języka używanego w domu oraz przynależności do wyznania religijnego'). Poland's 16 voivodeships and 380 powiats match the packet's admin1 and admin2 counts exactly. Religion was voluntary with a large 'refused' share that must stay visible in the composition; ethnicity may need a choice between first and any identification. Nothing is currently filled, so this is new data, not a replacement.
